disable_ml_frame_generation_and_optiscal: Disable ML frame generation and OptiScaler in the Advanced tab before enabling AFMF.
afmf_generates_one_in_between_frame_per_: AFMF generates one in-between frame per real frame (2×) from the game's image. Follow the steps below; changes save automatically.
install_afmf_in_settings_add_ons_the_ins: Install AFMF in Settings → Add-ons. The installation is shared across games.
install_afmf_in_settings_add_ons_to_unlo: Install AFMF in Settings → Add-ons to unlock activation.
enabling_afmf_automatically_disables_mak: Enabling AFMF automatically disables MAKO for this game.
register_this_installation_in_the_main_l: Register this installation in the main library to configure its launch.
afmf_reads_its_options_when_the_game_sta: AFMF reads its options when the game starts. Any change applies on the next launch.
with_the_peligames_overlay_on_performanc: With the PeliGames overlay on (Performance tab), open the in-game panel with your configured shortcut to view the AFMF settings sent to the game. It cannot change them during play.
steam_has_pending_changes_apply_them_bes: Steam has pending changes. Apply them beside the Play button.
game_running_close_it_to_change_afmf: Game running: close it to change AFMF.
defaults_work_for_most_games_adjust_if_y: Defaults work for most games. Adjust if you notice artifacts or a performance drop.
quality_reduces_artifacts_performance_co: Quality reduces artifacts; Performance costs the GPU less.
high_follows_wide_motion_at_a_higher_cos: High follows wide motion, at a higher cost.
when_motion_is_too_fast_blend_smooths_re: When motion is too fast: blend smooths, repeat avoids warping.
below_this_real_fps_no_frame_is_generate: Below this real FPS no frame is generated. 0 always generates.
keeps_menus_and_hud_still_without_warpin: Keeps menus and HUD still, without warping.
spaces_frames_evenly_holds_each_real_fra: Spaces frames evenly; holds each real frame slightly.
gamescope_detected_afmf_s_compatible_mod: Gamescope detected: AFMF's compatible mode is enabled automatically.
tested_on_amd_rx_7000_and_rx_9000_cards_: Tested on AMD RX 7000 and RX 9000 cards with the RADV driver. Other cards are untested. Requires Vulkan 1.1 or newer, directly or through Proton's DXVK/VKD3D.
fixed_2_multiplier_a_game_already_at_the: Fixed 2× multiplier. A game already at the monitor's refresh rate with V-Sync gets no generated frames. Thin, fast objects may vanish from in-between frames.
do_not_combine_with_mako_lsfg_vk_or_opti: Do not combine with MAKO, lsfg-vk or OptiScaler frame generation. MangoHUD may count only real frames.
